description: Elaborately fashioned platters, vessels, and containers, often decorated with embellishments that indicated their owner’s status, were displayed on the banquet tables of Renaissance Italy. Cisterns such as this were filled with cold water and used to cool wine bottles at feasts. Decorated by the Italian ceramic painter Francesco Durantino, this work typifies the Renaissance interest in both Christian imagery and scenes from pagan antiquity.
title: Wine Cistern
